inventory-item-html.title: Product Detail Page
inventory-item-html.notes: The product is selected by the id query parameter; all ids share this one page. The primary button toggles between 'Add to cart' and 'Remove' in place and updates the cart badge.

checkout-complete-html.title: Order Confirmation Page
checkout-complete-html.notes: Also offers a 'Generate PDF order' button (not exercised).

dynamic-catalog-lazy-load-html.title: Dynamic Catalog - Lazy Load Page
dynamic-catalog-lazy-load-html.notes: Products load progressively; four trailing 'Loading…' placeholders were still visible after ~3s. Product cards are read-only: clicking a card name does nothing, and there is no link to the product detail page and no add-to-cart. Names carry size suffixes such as (XS).

dynamic-catalog-spinner-html.title: Dynamic Catalog - Spinner Page
dynamic-catalog-spinner-html.notes: Shows a 'Loading' spinner first; after ~5s it resolves to six read-only product cards. There is no link to the product detail page and no add-to-cart.

dynamic-catalog-slider-html.title: Dynamic Catalog - Slider Page
dynamic-catalog-slider-html.notes: The slider auto-advances every few seconds, so the product shown after clicking a dot can change shortly afterwards (immediately after a click it showed the selected product once, and a different one a few seconds later). Product name and price are read-only: clicking them does nothing, and there is no link to the product detail page.
